storyline.real: A driveshaft failure in qualifying leaves Verstappen fifteenth on the grid, with Pérez on pole. Pérez takes the lead back from Alonso on lap 4 while Verstappen climbs into the top four. Stroll's stopped car brings out the safety car, and the leaders all pit for hards under it. Verstappen restarts fourth, passes Russell and Alonso, and chips away at a 5.4 s gap, but a driveshaft worry costs him time and Pérez wins by 5.355 s.
storyline.headline: Verstappen wins in Jeddah from fifteenth on the grid

mastery.label: Finish second or better on one stop

hidden.label: Finish second or better without a single lap of tyre management

eras.briefing: Jeddah, 2023. A driveshaft failure in qualifying put Verstappen fifteenth on the grid, and Pérez started on pole. Fifteen laps in, you run Verstappen sixth on mediums, 21.4 s behind Pérez, and the cars around you have started to stop. Finish second at least, and if you can, beat your team-mate.
